scope_limits: The two directly inspected stills for each role are both at 0.5 seconds. Five recorded pose times per role were separately checked numerically by real Three.js/Chromium loading.
Source identities, keyed provenance, exact UV/PNG bytes and dependency revisions are established by independent byte/source readers; visible geometry alone does not establish those identities.
This records finite GLB/0.20 loading and rendering, not Unreal import, live physical simulation or complete product acceptance.
